rows.abstract: "National Consultancy Act of 1995" Defines terms under this proposed measure. Seeks to regulate and establish uniform guidelines for the hiring of consultants for infrastructure and other government projects. Limits participation to Filipino consultants and states the instances when foreign consultants may be hired. Provides for: (1) accreditation and selection of consultants; (2) financing and cost of consultancy; and (3) independence of consultancy services.

rows.abstract: Requires the Social Security System (SSS) to set aside a portion of its investment reserve fund to be made available for loan to SSS pensioners who want to venture to livelihood projects. Provides that the amount of loan shall be determined by the actual livelihood credit needs of the applicant or not less than Twenty-Five Thousand (P25,000.00) pesos and interest rates to be charged shall not exceed interest rates charged on short and medium term loans to SSS covered employees and that said loan shall be paid back out of applicant's pension.

rows.abstract: Seeks to impose penalties of imprisonment of not less than two (2) years  and a fine of not less than P5,000.00 and not more than P10,000.00 or both on persons who manipulate or rig board examination results, make a leak of the questions to be askedon the examinations, or tamper the grades.  In case the offender is an officer or employee of the Professional Regulations Commission or a Member of the Board of Examiners, he shall be removed from office and shall suffer the penalty of perpetual absolute disqualificatio n from public office, in addition to the penalties prescribed above.

rows.abstract: Seeks to exempt Filipino Overseas Contract Workers(OCWs) earning Ten Thousand ($10.000) US Dollars or less per annum and remitted through the system from Philippine income taxation. Aims to encourage Filipino OCWs to remit through the Philippine banking system, rather than through nonbank channels, thereby helping the country boost its economy.
